profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer, Infrastructure Engineering and Automation
profile.summary: Salesforce is the world’s #1 customer relationship management (CRM) platform.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, Infrastructure and Engineering Services (LMTS)
positions.description: The Account Engagement PIES (Pardot Infrastructure Engineering Services) is an agile team managing public cloud infrastructure, and building tools to manage that infrastructure, that enable developers at Salesforce to be more productive and deploy software safely and rapidly. We are especially focused on machine image standardization and automation, patching automation, and non-container-based configuration management.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, Database Engineering and Automation
Lead Software Engineer, Performance Engineering
positions.description:
Marketing Cloud LMTS (Lead Member of Technical Staff)

-Scaling enterprise level products and databases for Performance.
-Experience running large data systems at a massive scale (300B queries a day)
-Keep the broader team aligned around our common definition of performance; holds teams and peers to a high quality bar
-Develop forward thinking proof of concept; advance our data layer
-Lead Project to replace product wide database monitoring ; Vividcortex, Monyog, SQLDM, PMM
-Automation and alerting on a enterprise level
-Own software features and systems; define their long-term health while improving health of surrounding software systems
-Develop and socialize documentation that is engaging, informative, and creates clarity
-Identify, decompose, and solve complex problems in testing. Offer solutions, identify and rally the right people, and successfully drive resolution
-Focus on performance and scaling of Enterprise level MySQL, RDS, Aurora 
-LAMP Stack
-Mentor new and developing teammates in database performance. Train and educate development broader team members. 
-Create custom dashboards and alerting using ; Prometheus, Zabbix, Grafana, Netdata
-Multiple time Hack-a-thon participant
-Create forward thinking projects and introducing next generation technology into the stack.

positions.title: MySQL DBA
positions.description:
- "Measure twice, cut once"
- Amazon Web Services eco-system: EC2, S3, RDS, Aurora, Performance Insights, Grafana 
- Strong knowledge of Amazons Console
- DB Stack Upgrades 
- Maintain data integrity with 'zero' data loss
- Lead projects on MySQL EC2 to RDS Migration / Cutover with no downtime
- RDS / Aurora monitoring 
- Lead MySQL DBA for Words With Friends 
- Automation of daily tasks 
- Work closely to ensure OKR milestones are met
- Work closely with game and application teams for all projects 
- Maintaining 1500+ production Database servers in cloud and datacenter environments
- Ability to proactively identify, troubleshoot and resolve live database systems issues
- Engineered and implemented solutions for large scale database/data center migrations, sharding & reverse sharding
- MySQL 5.5, 5.6, 5.7
- Solid knowledge in schema design principals with demonstrated aptitude to apply best practices for scalable designs and influence developers
- Solid knowledge of physical and logical database design
- A deep understanding of database systems and the factors that affect distributed system performance
- Experience supporting redundant systems with 24X7 availability requirement
- Backup and recovery
- Monitor and maintain space usage within the database
- Monitor and maintain availability and performance
- Provision and monitor security measures	
- Controlled production implementations	
- Create or re-create new database instances using Chef 
- Collaborate with departments as DB representative 
- Assist with large data movement between instances and clusters	
- Strong SQL skills
- Experience maintaining large databases(>1TB)
- Participate in SOX audit process
- Percona toolset
- Vividcortex , Data Dog, Instrumental Implementation for teams
- Jira / Atlasssian MySQL migration to Next Gen
- GDPR

positions.title: Senior MySQL Database Administrator
positions.description:
- Setup and maintain production MySQL instances
- Monitor and tune the performance of multiple MySQL servers
- Monitor database events, troubleshoot and resolve problems
- Monitor database backup and validate recovery plans
- Work with development teams for schema design and query tuning
- Design database security roles; enroll users and audit database security
- Follow change management policies to manage change in database environments
- Coordinate with Apps support and application development teams for capacity planning and application design

positions.title: Principal Consultant/Database Developer
positions.description:
Supporting the migration for the nations largest financial acquisition when Wells Fargo acquired Wachovia, providing support to the server and customer migration projects of wholesale accounts

Act as Oracle and Informatica lead for support team in production environments providing monitoring, troubleshooting and debugging for any issues across applications

positions.title: Oracle Database Developer
positions.description:
Member of an Oracle DBA team which supports over twenty production Oracle 10g 10.2.0.5 Cluster Databases with Grid Control running on Red Hat Linux ES 4 

Responsible for managing a database queue, performing ad hoc database requests including: queries, updates, backups and restores, creating triggers, procedures, indexes, table spaces, data files, control files and database links; Write bash shell scripts, SQL scripts and troubleshoot production issues with confidence

positions.title: Systems Operations Analyst
positions.description: Developed processes to address the needs of incoming client feeds and worked closely with team members to test, track and report defeats during application launch

educations.schoolName: University of New York at Buffalo

projects.title: MySQL migrations
projects.description: implementing the database migration plan, performing load testing
